subtasks.description: Declare four 32-bit registers w0, w1, w2, w3 and all internal combinational wires (rot_word, sub_word, T_word, next_w0..next_w3, rcon_out, sb0_out..sb3_out) needed by downstream blocks; match port/signal widths from the module interface.
constraints: Declare exactly four 32-bit registers w0, w1, w2, w3.
All wire declarations must match port widths and naming from S003.

subtasks.description: Instantiate one aes_rcon (clk, kld, out→rcon_out) and four aes_sbox modules (inputs from rotated w3 bytes, outputs sb0_out..sb3_out); map ports to module-level signals exactly.
constraints: Instantiate exactly 1 aes_rcon and 4 aes_sbox; no extra instances.
Sbox inputs must be driven by rotated bytes of w3 as per RotWord ordering.

subtasks.description: Implement the synchronous register load/update process: on posedge clk, if kld=1 load w0..w3 from key[127:0] with specified byte mapping, else update them with next_w0..next_w3 from the combinational network.
constraints: Use only kld to select load vs update; no reset logic.
Key loading must map key[127:96]→w0, [95:64]→w1, [63:32]→w2, [31:0]→w3 exactly.

subtasks.description: Compute RotWord, SubWord (using sbox outputs), T_word (SubWord XOR rcon_out), and next round key words next_w0..next_w3 using current w0..w3 and T_word per the AES-128 key expansion recurrence.
constraints: Use exact RotWord byte reordering: {w3[23:0], w3[31:24]}.
SubWord byte order: sb0_out is MSB, sb3_out is LSB of sub_word.
next_w0 = w0 ^ T_word; next_w1 = w1 ^ next_w0; next_w2 = w2 ^ next_w1; next_w3 = w3 ^ next_w2; no pipelining.

subtasks.description: Drive output ports wo_0, wo_1, wo_2, wo_3 with the current values of the key word registers w0, w1, w2, w3 continuously.
constraints: Outputs must always reflect current register values; no added latency or gating.
